title: Dungeon Island
description:
• Play the incredible storyline of Dungeon Island​ as a brave adventurer

• Free Dungeon Island's villagers from demons by defeating the final boss

• Explore an infinite procedural world

• Venture into dark caves full of treasures and threats​​

• Craft and build using the resources you collect

• Survive day-night cycles

• Plant trees and make a farm

• Craft and build using the resources you collect

• Complete all Steam achievements
Lore:Dungeon Island is an infinite mysterious archipelago. For many years has been the home of countless adventurers who enjoy exploring.
Each adventurer lived a daydream by discovering new treasures and unknown islands every day.
But one day one of them while adventuring in a cave discovered something that changed everything. 
Evil monsters began to emerge from caves.
Dungeon Island became soon a nightmare for adventurers and only the bravest remained to try to discover the origin of monsters and return Dungeon Island to its former glory.
description_short: Explore a procedural 2D world with an epic storyline! Discover islands, caves, build and fight demons
